title: A lane does not close until its records pull request has merged
why: Owner, Nov 1 17:44 CST, forwarding a home repo session's finding: the gap is in every repo, not only home.
note:
Nov 6 11:51 CST (coordinator audit, Explore sonnet; PR head reachable from origin/main): DONE, evidence #989 on main.
Shape: a lane's archive or close is refused while its record step (the records PR) is unmerged. Incident: home's wheel lane closed before its records PR landed. Ready: no open question. Port: yes, every repo.
Doing, Nov 1 18:40 CST: draft PR #989 reviewed, with batch runner 6. Built: guard rule lane-closes-after-records refuses archive_session on a lane while an open PR's head branch equals its step id exactly. Known miss: lane PRs on other branch names. 07:39 CST Nov 13, runner 10: on its third try, the archive guard could not read the branches or PRs of lane session_013NEJL2Xy82mnmoxrLgjJ8W, so the lane stays open in an unknown state. That lane's sources include a second repo, shivinate7/session-mailbox (get_session 07:35 CST); unconfirmed whether that is the cause. A guard that cannot read should report unknown and name the read that failed. 09:15 CST Nov 13: the 2Xy82 refusal was the lane's second repo (shivinate7/session-mailbox); add_repo fixed it at 09:08 CST. Mechanical fix: step archive-refusal-names-add-repo.
